title: docker-restapi-sidecar.gz rebuilt on every build due to .PHONY dependency
author: securely1g
body:
## Description
`docker-restapi-sidecar.gz` is rebuilt on every `make all` invocation even when no source files have changed. This wastes build time and resources.

## Root Cause
In `rules/docker-restapi-sidecar.mk` line 50:
```makefile
.PHONY: docker-restapi-sidecar-ut
docker-restapi-sidecar-ut: $(PYTHON_WHEELS_PATH)/sonic_py_common-1.0-py3-none-any.whl-install
	@echo "Running unit tests for systemd_stub.py..."
	@PYTHONPATH=dockers/docker-restapi-sidecar \
		python3 -m pytest -q dockers/docker-restapi-sidecar/cli-plugin-tests

target/docker-restapi-sidecar.gz: docker-restapi-sidecar-ut
```

The `.PHONY: docker-restapi-sidecar-ut` declaration means the target has no actual file artifact. Make treats phony targets as always out-of-date, so `docker-restapi-sidecar.gz` always rebuilds as a side effect.

## Impact
- Docker image rebuilds unnecessarily on every `make all` call
- Wastes 1-2 minutes per build cycle
- Affects all stages (bookworm, trixie, etc.)

## Solution Options
1. **Create a stamp file:** Generate `target/.docker-restapi-sidecar-ut.done` when tests pass, use that as dependency instead of .PHONY target
2. **Conditional rebuild:** Only rebuild if source files in `dockers/docker-restapi-sidecar/` changed
3. **Separate test target:** Make unit tests a separate target, not a build prerequisite

## Environment
- Platform: VS
- All BLDENV stages (bookworm, trixie, etc.)
- Arch: amd64

## Reproduction
```bash
make SONIC_BUILD_JOBS=4 all
# Observe docker-restapi-sidecar.gz rebuilds
make SONIC_BUILD_JOBS=4 all
# It rebuilds again even though nothing changed
```

linkedPullRequests.title: Fix: Remove .PHONY dependency from docker-restapi-sidecar.mk to prevent unconditional rebuilds
linkedPullRequests.author: copilot-swe-agent
linkedPullRequests.body:
`docker-restapi-sidecar.gz` was rebuilding on every `make all` because `target/docker-restapi-sidecar.gz` depended on a `.PHONY` target — Make always treats phony targets as stale, triggering unconditional downstream rebuilds.

#### Why I did it

Removed the `.PHONY: docker-restapi-sidecar-ut` target and its dependency on `target/docker-restapi-sidecar.gz`. The unit tests in `cli-plugin-tests/` are already run automatically by the existing docker UT schema in `slave.mk`:

```makefile
# slave.mk line 1239 - runs automatically for any docker with cli-plugin-tests/
if [ -d $($*.gz_PATH)/cli-plugin-tests/ ] && [ ! "$(BUILD_SKIP_TEST)" = "y" ]; then
    pushd $($*.gz_PATH)/cli-plugin-tests
    PYTHONPATH=$(shell realpath $($*.gz_PATH)):${PYTHONPATH} pytest-3 -v
    popd
fi
```

No test coverage is lost — tests run during the docker build when the image is actually rebuilt.

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it

Removed the following from `rules/docker-restapi-sidecar.mk`:
- `.PHONY: docker-restapi-sidecar-ut` declaration
- `docker-restapi-sidecar-ut` recipe
- `target/docker-restapi-sidecar.gz: docker-restapi-sidecar-ut` dependency

#### How to verify it

```bash
make SONIC_BUILD_JOBS=4 target/docker-restapi-sidecar.gz
# First build completes normally

make SONIC_BUILD_JOBS=4 target/docker-restapi-sidecar.gz
# Second invocation skips rebuild (nothing changed)
```
